entities.text:
High Court Of Jammu & Kashmir And Ladakh
 At Jammu
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rahul Bharti, Judge
 Order

01. By virtue of an award dated 08.04.2023 on file No. 15/2017 passed by the Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal (MACT), Samba a compensation of an amount of Rs. 77,04,000/- along with interest @7.5% per annum from the date of institution of the claim petition, which is 05.08.2017 till actual realization has been awarded in favour of the respondent No. 1 - Akhil Virdhi, a 27 year old person, who has been rendered physically disabled to 100% in the form of 25% physical impairment by reference to moderate arthria speech defect, border line mental retardation with 25% intellectual impairment and moderate hemiparesis with 50% motor system disability.

02. Against the said award, the Insurance Company i.e. Universal Sompo General Insurance Co.
Ltd., has come in present statutory appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 assailing the award on all grounds including quantum of compensation.

entities.text:
Universal Sompo General Insurance Co.
Ltd.
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
03. This Court while admitting the appeal, in terms of an order dated 24.07.2023, came to direct deposit of the 50% of the awarded amount which came to be deposited by the appellant as is borne out from an office noting dated 02.09.2013 certifying deposit of an amount of Rs. 55,61,192/-.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant/respondent No. 1 - Akhil Virdhi (injured) has come forward with an application CM No. 2380/2024 seeking release of the part amount of the 50% awarded amount deposited.
05. Given the condition of the applicant/respondent No. 1 - Akhil Virdhi, it requires no telling that the applicant/respondent No. 1 is need of money in order to cater to his physical well being.

Accordingly, this Court allows release of an of Rs. 25,00,000/-
(twenty five lacs) in favour of the applicant/respondent No. 1.

06. The Registrar Judicial, Jammu to release the aforesaid amount of Rs. 25,00,000/- (twenty five lacs) into the bank account of the applicant/respondent No. 1 - Akhil Virdhi by way of A/C payee cheque to be handed over to the father of the applicant/respondent No. 1 - Akhil Virdhi, to be identified by the counsel for the applicant/respondent No. 1.
07.

Learned counsel for the applicant/respondent No. 1 to provide bank account particulars of the applicant/respondent No. 1 to the Registrar Judicial, Jammu for the purpose of seeking release of the amount.
08. CM No. 2380/2024 is, accordingly, disposed of.
